items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially active vs Raiders despite calf injury after GTD/optimistic reports.
items.why: Optimism from team/sources; feeling better Saturday, minor calf.
items.implication: Must-start WR1; reverse any bench plans or Davante Adams/Higbee pivots.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected in favorable matchup.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall inactive after GTD/pessimistic; sources said unlikely, not full participant yet returning from quad.
items.why: Limited practice, early in return from multi-week quad strain.
items.opportunity: Backup RB (Allen) full workhorse in good matchup.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson OUT (ankle); was Q, close to playing but ruled out, expected next week.
items.why: Ankle limited practice; sources indicate near-return but held.
items.implication: Huntley start; Flowers/Andrews/Likely volume shifts possible.
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers remains viable but QB downgrade.

items.text: Jonah Coleman first game back led Broncos snaps 50%, rush 41%, routes 34%; JK Dobbins only 21% snaps. Berry reiterated preseason love and roster him 100%.
items.why: Confirmed lead shares post-activation from IR.
items.implication: Coleman clear upgrade/priority add; Dobbins downgrade to committee/handcuff.
items.opportunity: Coleman RB2/flex volume; reverse Dobbins sole lead.

items.text: Vikings RB Aaron Jones knee injury from Sunday not significant; source says day-to-day.
items.implication: Likely plays soon; Mason was activated as depth.
items.opportunity: Monitor for next week; Jordan Mason handcuff.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain; earlier expected to resume lead back role.
items.why: In-game hamstring; purposeful slide attempt noted.
items.implication: Monitor; Tracy also hamstring could create committee or backup surge.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, other Giants RBs elevate.
items.conflict: Pre-game lead expectation vs post injury.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle turned on purposeful slide; would have been tilting if serious while correctly not scoring.
items.why: Post-slide assessment; purposeful and correct play.

items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT; Saquon Barkley expected to play.
items.implication: PHI pass game thinner; Goedert/Hurts elevated; start Saquon if active.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to remaining WRs/TE; Barkley RB1 volume.

items.text: Josh Jacobs, Tank Dell, Jordan Mason, Jonah Coleman, Christian Kirk IN/activated; multiple returns.
items.implication: Jacobs immediate start; Dell limited role debut post-2024.
items.opportunity: Jacobs lead back; Dell stash/watch routes.

items.text: Seahawks opening 21-day practice window for RB Jadarian Price (chest); eligible return Week 8. Charbonnet still plan-limited.
items.why: Coach Macdonald announced; help on way.
items.implication: Stash/monitor for W8+; depth for SEA RBs behind Walker/Charbonnet.

items.text: Nico Collins led Texans with 24 routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks; Tank Dell only 6 in first game since 2024, Noel left early turf toe.
items.why: Post-Dell return and Noel exit data.
items.implication: Collins clear alpha; Dell limited re-acclimation.
items.opportunity: Collins high share continues; Dell stash.

items.text: Seahawks, Broncos, Vikings, Packers mentioned as potential Jonathan Taylor trade suitors ahead of Nov 10 deadline; Price status unsure but eligible W8.
items.why: Schefter names to watch; Levitan notes SEA need beyond JSN.
items.implication: JT value volatile; landing spot impacts ROS.
items.opportunity: If traded to contender, boost; Price as SEA depth.

items.text: Xavier Worthy ran 33 routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd game without Rashee Rice); has never topped 83 receiving yards in 37 games.
items.implication: Volume there but historical ceiling caps boom potential; monitor efficiency.
items.conflict: High opportunity vs career yardage max.

items.text: Garrett Wilson 29 routes, Omar Cooper 23 (efficient 12-248-2 on 13 targets season), AD Mitchell 18 on 33 Geno dropbacks.
items.implication: Wilson lead; Cooper efficiency breakout watch.
